item.title: Getting Started with Terraform
item.description: How to install terraform TEST Ansible is a powerful automation tool that simplifies the management of systems and applications. This guide will help you get started with Ansible, covering installation, basic concepts, and your first playbook. What is Ansible? Ansible is an open-source automation tool that allows you to automate tasks such as configuration management, application deployment, and orchestration. It uses a simple, human-readable language (YAML) to define automation tasks.
